name: mt_bench_ppl_small
description: A small benchmark suite for measuring language model perplexity on a curated set of MT-Bench related prompts. It is intended to provide a lightweight, reproducible measure of how well models predict next-token distributions on this subset. Useful for quick comparisons of generative LM calibration and likelihood performance.
reputation: A small, specialized dataset with limited adoption outside of a few research groups and model evaluation workflows.
